Q: Is SCSS still relevant alongside Tailwind CSS? A:

Well, that’s exactly the thing. My instructor gave us two options, but we ended up going with just SCSS; otherwise, I think Tailwind alone would have been enough for this project. From my side, I’ve more or less decided that for my next projects I’ll stick with Tailwind as the main approach. That said, I do agree with what you mentioned about SCSS, so I tried to get a thorough enough understanding of it that I can read and work with existing SCSS code comfortably. Thanks for the insight!

Q: Laravel vue 3 remove /build/ from url A:

I ran into the same issue when running playwright tests.

Given vue router

import { createRouter, createWebHistory } from 'vue-router'

const router = createRouter({
  history: createWebHistory(import.meta.env.BASE_URL),
  routes: [
    ...
  ],
})

In Vite doc: import.meta.env.BASE_URL is the base url the app is being served from. This is determined by the base config option in vite.config.ts. So we may update vite.config.ts as

export default defineConfig({
  base: '/',       // Add this line to explicitly set it to /
  plugins: [
    ...
  ],
})

Restart the server to find the web app URL no longer with "build".

In any case if you wish to add back "build" in URL, just update vite.config.ts to

base: '/build'

Q: What's the best way to learn Java in 2026 in your opinion? A:

To start with, do you think learning Java can be different from learning anything else? There are too many ways to learn the topic, so the detailed answer can hardly make sense.

Just a few points:

  1. Learning programming and computing science is more important than any specific language.
  2. However, learning specific languages is the only way to learn everything else.
  3. The main source of information is the standard documentation.
  4. The main way of learning programming is by practicing programming.
  5. Beware of the illusion of knowledge. You can say that you understand a topic only if you can use all the related techniques to make a correctly working code.
  6. Doing exercises and developing prototypes is not the waste of time. Just the opposite: it is a huge saving of time in the long term.

Q: Looking for an idea for a project to work on while studying programming A:

A good idea is the idea you found yourself. It is a well-known fact that the best software is the software developers write for themselves. Look around: how could you improve your productivity and your comfort? Not only your work, but also comminication, arts, hobby... you name it.

Another good source of requirements is your friends, relatives, and other people. Usually, they simply have no idea what can help them. However, you can pay close attention to their activities and find the ways to make their life more convenient, productive, and reduce the waste of their time, and so on.
